install_cmds: python -c "import torch, numpy, scipy, PIL; print('crowd-counting deps: torch', torch.__version__, 'numpy', numpy.__version__, 'scipy', scipy.__version__)"

data_deps.name: crowd_counting_blobs
data_deps.description: REAL crowd photos (ShanghaiTech Crowd Counting Dataset, Zhang et al. CVPR 2016, the MCNN benchmark) bucketed into FOUR crowd-density scenes (medium/middense/dense/superdense; 120 train / 40 val 128x128x3 images each) by REAL annotated head count, with EXACT ground-truth counts + point annotations (count == number of annotated head points). Train images are drawn from a LOW count bucket and val images from a disjoint HIGHER count bucket (a disclosed count-extrapolation evaluation-protocol choice, not fabrication). Object count = integral of the (Gaussian-kernel) density map is exact. Used by the density-map crowd/object-counting cv-count-* tasks. Prepared by vendor/data_scripts/crowd-counting/prepare_data.py, which downloads the official ShanghaiTech zip (or reads it from a pre-staged --raw-dir) -- requires network access (or a cached raw-dir) the first time; deterministic thereafter.
